subject: RBI KFS compliance — multilingual borrower documents for {company}
body:
Hi {name},

{personal_line}

I'm reaching out from Shabd AI (IIM-incubated; Top 30 at the India AI Impact Summit 2026).

The RBI's KFS mandate (circular RBI/2024-25/18, effective October 2024) requires all retail and MSME term loan documents, including Key Fact Statements, to be provided in a language the borrower can understand. For 2025-26 inspection cycles, supervisory observations on KFS language compliance are already being flagged.

For a bank like {company} operating across diverse geographies, this means KFS documents, loan agreements, and borrower communication need to be available across the regional languages your customers actually speak.

We help banks and regulated entities meet this requirement at scale, covering text and document localisation across 22 Indic languages with full contextual accuracy.

We support with:
- KFS and loan document localisation across regional languages
- Multilingual onboarding, consent, and KYC communication
- Branch staff training content in regional languages
- Customer-facing app and website localisation
- Multilingual grievance redress and servicing communication

We currently work with AU Small Finance Bank, Jana Small Finance Bank, and other regulated entities on exactly this.

Would it make sense to connect briefly on how {company} is approaching the KFS language requirement?

Best,
